fields.description: Which marketplace each customer belongs to. On a Sales Order with Flow = OR, choosing one of these customers fills in its Marketplace. A marketplace can have several customers; each customer belongs to one marketplace.
fields.label: Customer ↔ Marketplace

fields.description: The marketplace's commission on each Secondary Sale. At import: Secondary Rate without Commission = Secondary Rate × (1 − Commission %). Example: Secondary Rate 120 at 25% → 90. A marketplace without a row has 0% commission. Changing a % affects future imports only.
fields.label: Marketplace Commission

fields.description: How each marketplace's sales report is laid out: which columns hold the order ID, sale date, SKU, quantity and selling price. A marketplace without a row uses the standard columns marketplace_order_id, sale_date, marketplace_sku, qty, selling_price.
fields.label: Secondary Sales Import Formats

fields.description: Rate difference: the Secondary Rate without Commission against the Primary Rate. Each secondary sale posts it to the Rate Difference account; the month-end settlement clears it with a Credit Note (secondary lower) or Debit Note (secondary higher) against the Primary Sales Invoice the units came from.
fields.label: Rate Difference Settlement
Group Notes By
fields.description: Month: one credit note and one debit note per Primary Sales Invoice per month (month-end settlement).
Role allowed to submit notes and approve OR Primary Sales Trackers.
fields.label: Note Approver Role

fields.description: Off for month-end settlement: notes are made by Month-end Settlement.
fields.label: Create Draft Notes on Import
